raw_segments.text: Finally, it was stated at the outset that this system would not be here and at once
You cannot but plainly see that I have kept my word.
But I now leave my cedological system standing thus unfinished, even as the great cathedral
of Cologne was left, with the crane still standing upon the top of the uncompleted tower.
For small erections may be finished by their first architects, grand ones, true ones, ever
God keep me from ever completing anything.
This whole book is but a draft nay, but the draft of a draft.
Oh, time, strength, cash, and patience.
